snippet.title: The Hoff VS Hitler Longplay
snippet.description:
https://denshaeizo.itch.io/the-hoff-vs-hitler
This is a longplay of The Hoff VS Hitler from 2008 that shows the entire story mode and extra content. Game overs have been edited out (and there were many).

Chapters
00:00 - Intro
01:01 - Level 1 - Nazi Germany
01:53 - Level 2 - Green Hill Zone
04:28 - Level 3 - Kitt in Germany
06:43 - Level 4 - Hoff in Italy
09:07 - Scorpion enters the fray
09:53 - Level 5 - Super Secret Mega Nazi Desert Base
13:19 - Level 6 - The Hoff VS Scorpion
14:09 - Level 7 - Hitler's Torture Chamber
17:13 - Level 8 - Hitler's Doom Ship
19:56 - Hitler's escape
20:39 - Level 9 - Final Frontline Assault
25:25 - The Hoff confronts Hitler
26:10 - Final Boss - The Hoff VS Hitler
29:07 - Good ending
29:56 - Eradication mission briefing
31:05 - Bonus Level - Eradication
